meta.title: Qevora Booking — demo salon
meta.description: Installs Qevora Booking and fills a demo salon with services, staff, schedules, holidays, sample bookings and a ready booking page. No payment gateway, pay at the salon.
meta.author: qevorasoftware

options.blogdescription: Book a massage, facial or haircut — pay at the salon.

steps.code:
<?php
/**
 * Seeds demo content for the WordPress Playground blueprint.
 *
 * This file is not loaded by the plugin. It is embedded into
 * docs/playground/blueprint.json as a runPHP step so that the public
 * Playground preview opens with a fully populated salon.
 */

require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( 'QVB_Services' ) ) {
	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
	activate_plugin( 'qevora-booking/qevora-booking.php' );
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'QVB_Services' ) || ! class_exists( 'QVB_Bookings' ) ) {
	return;
}

QVB_Database::install();
QVB_Capabilities::add();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- settings --
$hours = array();

for ( $day = 0; $day < 7; $day++ ) {
	$hours[ $day ] = array(
		'enabled'     => 0 === $day ? 0 : 1,
		'start'       => '10:00',
		'end'         => '20:00',
		'break_start' => '14:00',
		'break_end'   => '15:00',
	);
}

QVB_Settings::update(
	array(
		'business_name'    => 'Qevora Demo Salon',
		'business_email'   => 'hello@qevora.test',
		'business_phone'   => '+91 98765 43210',
		'business_address' => '12 Riverside Walk, Surat, Gujarat 395007',
		'timezone'         => 'Asia/Kolkata',
		'currency'         => 'INR',
		'accent_color'     => '#7c3aed',
		'slot_interval'    => 30,
		'default_buffer'   => 10,
		'min_notice'       => 0,
		'max_advance'      => 90,
		'approval_mode'    => 'auto',
		'business_hours'   => $hours,
		'enable_emails'    => 1,
		'admin_email'      => 'owner@qevora.test',
		'from_name'        => 'Qevora Demo Salon',
		'from_email'       => 'booking@qevora.test',
		'spam_protection'  => 0,
	)
);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- page --
$page    = get_page_by_path( 'book-appointment' );
$page_id = $page ? (int) $page->ID : 0;

if ( ! $page_id ) {
	$page_id = (int) wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_title'   => 'Book an appointment',
			'post_name'    => 'book-appointment',
			'post_content' => '[qevora_booking title="Book your visit"]',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_type'    => 'page',
		)
	);
}

if ( $page_id ) {
	QVB_Settings::update( array( 'booking_page_id' => $page_id ) );
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- categories --
$existing_categories = array();

foreach ( QVB_Categories::all() as $category ) {
	$existing_categories[ strtolower( $category->name ) ] = (int) $category->id;
}

$category_ids = array();

foreach ( array(
	'Massage' => 'Relaxation and therapeutic bodywork.',
	'Hair'    => 'Cuts, colour and styling.',
	'Skin'    => 'Facials and skincare rituals.',
) as $name => $description ) {
	$key = strtolower( $name );

	if ( isset( $existing_categories[ $key ] ) ) {
		$category_ids[ $name ] = $existing_categories[ $key ];
		continue;
	}

	$created = QVB_Categories::save(
		array(
			'name'        => $name,
			'description' => $description,
			'status'      => 'active',
		)
	);

	if ( ! is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
		$category_ids[ $name ] = (int) $created;
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- services --
$existing_services = array();

foreach ( QVB_Services::all() as $service ) {
	$existing_services[ strtolower( $service->name ) ] = (int) $service->id;
}

$service_defs = array(
	array( 'name' => 'Signature Massage', 'category' => 'Massage', 'duration' => 60, 'buffer' => 15, 'price' => 1500, 'description' => 'Our most-loved full-body massage with warm oils and medium pressure. Includes a herbal tea finish.' ),
	array( 'name' => 'Deep Tissue Massage', 'category' => 'Massage', 'duration' => 90, 'buffer' => 15, 'price' => 2200, 'description' => 'Slow, firm strokes that release stubborn knots in the back, shoulders and neck.' ),
	array( 'name' => 'Gel Manicure', 'category' => 'Hair', 'duration' => 45, 'buffer' => 10, 'price' => 900, 'description' => 'Shape, cuticle care and a chip-resistant gel colour that lasts up to three weeks.' ),
	array( 'name' => 'Haircut & Style', 'category' => 'Hair', 'duration' => 45, 'buffer' => 10, 'price' => 700, 'description' => 'Consultation, wash, precision cut and a blow-dry finish.' ),
	array( 'name' => 'Glow Facial', 'category' => 'Skin', 'duration' => 60, 'buffer' => 10, 'price' => 1800, 'description' => 'Double cleanse, gentle exfoliation, lymphatic massage and a brightening mask.' ),
);

$service_ids = array();

foreach ( $service_defs as $service ) {
	$key = strtolower( $service['name'] );

	if ( isset( $existing_services[ $key ] ) ) {
		$service_ids[ $service['name'] ] = $existing_services[ $key ];
		continue;
	}

	$created = QVB_Services::save(
		array(
			'name'        => $service['name'],
			'category_id' => isset( $category_ids[ $service['category'] ] ) ? $category_ids[ $service['category'] ] : 0,
			'description' => $service['description'],
			'duration'    => $service['duration'],
			'buffer_time' => $service['buffer'],
			'price'       => $service['price'],
			'status'      => 'active',
		)
	);

	if ( ! is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
		$service_ids[ $service['name'] ] = (int) $created;
	}
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- staff --
$existing_staff = array();

foreach ( QVB_Staff::all() as $member ) {
	$existing_staff[ strtolower( $member->name ) ] = (int) $member->id;
}

$staff_defs = array(
	array( 'name' => 'Aisha Khan', 'title' => 'Senior massage therapist', 'color' => '#7c3aed', 'bio' => 'Twelve years of therapeutic massage, specialising in deep tissue and prenatal care.', 'services' => array( 'Signature Massage', 'Deep Tissue Massage' ) ),
	array( 'name' => 'Riya Patel', 'title' => 'Hair stylist', 'color' => '#db2777', 'bio' => 'Precision cutting and colour, with a soft spot for lived-in waves.', 'services' => array( 'Haircut & Style', 'Gel Manicure' ) ),
	array( 'name' => 'Meera Joshi', 'title' => 'Skin therapist', 'color' => '#059669', 'bio' => 'Results-driven facials that still feel like a spa afternoon.', 'services' => array( 'Glow Facial' ) ),
);

$staff_ids = array();

foreach ( $staff_defs as $member ) {
	$key = strtolower( $member['name'] );

	if ( isset( $existing_staff[ $key ] ) ) {
		$staff_ids[ $member['name'] ] = $existing_staff[ $key ];
	} else {
		$created = QVB_Staff::save(
			array(
				'name'               => $member['name'],
				'job_title'          => $member['title'],
				'bio'                => $member['bio'],
				'color'              => $member['color'],
				'status'             => 'active',
				'use_business_hours' => 1,
				'email'              => sanitize_title( $member['name'] ) . '@qevora.test',
			)
		);

		if ( is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$staff_ids[ $member['name'] ] = (int) $created;
	}

	$ids = array();

	foreach ( $member['services'] as $service_name ) {
		if ( isset( $service_ids[ $service_name ] ) ) {
			$ids[] = $service_ids[ $service_name ];
		}
	}

	if ( $ids ) {
		QVB_Staff::set_services( $staff_ids[ $member['name'] ], $ids );
	}
}

// Meera works afternoons only, to show a custom weekly schedule.
if ( isset( $staff_ids['Meera Joshi'] ) && QVB_Staff::schedule( $staff_ids['Meera Joshi'] ) === array() ) {
	$rows = array();

	foreach ( array( 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ) as $day ) {
		$rows[] = array(
			'day_of_week' => $day,
			'start'       => '12:00',
			'end'         => '20:00',
			'break_start' => '',
			'break_end'   => '',
		);
	}

	$saved = QVB_Availability::save_schedule( $staff_ids['Meera Joshi'], $rows );

	if ( ! is_wp_error( $saved ) ) {
		QVB_Availability::set_use_business_hours( $staff_ids['Meera Joshi'], 0 );
	}
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions --
if ( ! QVB_Availability::exceptions( array( 'scope' => 'upcoming' ) ) ) {
	QVB_Availability::save_exception(
		array(
			'staff_id'  => 0,
			'from_date' => QVB_Utils::date_from_now( 12 ),
			'to_date'   => QVB_Utils::date_from_now( 12 ),
			'type'      => 'closed',
			'note'      => 'Salon closed for a team training day.',
		)
	);

	QVB_Availability::save_exception(
		array(
			'staff_id'  => 0,
			'from_date' => QVB_Utils::date_from_now( 20 ),
			'to_date'   => QVB_Utils::date_from_now( 20 ),
			'type'      => 'closed',
			'note'      => 'Public holiday.',
		)
	);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- bookings --
$existing_emails = $GLOBALS['wpdb']->get_col( 'SELECT DISTINCT customer_email FROM ' . QVB_Database::table( 'bookings' ) );
$existing_emails = array_map( 'strtolower', (array) $existing_emails );

$demo_bookings = array(
	array(
		'service' => 'Signature Massage',
		'staff'   => 'Aisha Khan',
		'offset'  => 1,
		'time'    => '11:00',
		'name'    => 'Priya Sharma',
		'email'   => 'priya@example.com',
		'phone'   => '+91 90000 11111',
		'notes'   => 'First visit — medium pressure please.',
	),
	array(
		'service' => 'Glow Facial',
		'staff'   => 'Meera Joshi',
		'offset'  => 1,
		'time'    => '15:00',
		'name'    => 'Ananya Rao',
		'email'   => 'ananya@example.com',
		'phone'   => '+91 90000 22222',
		'notes'   => '',
	),
	array(
		'service' => 'Haircut & Style',
		'staff'   => 'Riya Patel',
		'offset'  => 2,
		'time'    => '12:00',
		'name'    => 'Neha Mehta',
		'email'   => 'neha@example.com',
		'phone'   => '+91 90000 33333',
		'notes'   => 'Shoulder-length bob, wants styling tips.',
	),
);

foreach ( $demo_bookings as $demo ) {
	if ( ! isset( $service_ids[ $demo['service'] ], $staff_ids[ $demo['staff'] ] ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	if ( in_array( strtolower( $demo['email'] ), $existing_emails, true ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	$date  = QVB_Utils::date_from_now( (int) $demo['offset'] );
	$slots = QVB_Availability::get_slots( $service_ids[ $demo['service'] ], $staff_ids[ $demo['staff'] ], $date, array( 'admin' => true ) );

	if ( ! $slots ) {
		continue;
	}

	$time = isset( $slots[ $demo['time'] ] ) ? $demo['time'] : (string) array_key_first( $slots );

	QVB_Bookings::create(
		array(
			'service_id' => $service_ids[ $demo['service'] ],
			'staff_id'   => $staff_ids[ $demo['staff'] ],
			'date'       => $date,
			'time'       => $time,
			'name'       => $demo['name'],
			'email'      => $demo['email'],
			'phone'      => $demo['phone'],
			'notes'      => $demo['notes'],
			'consent'    => 1,
		),
		'admin'
	);
}

// One request waiting for approval.
if ( isset( $service_ids['Deep Tissue Massage'], $staff_ids['Aisha Khan'] ) && ! in_array( 'kavya@example.com', $existing_emails, true ) ) {
	$date  = QVB_Utils::date_from_now( 3 );
	$slots = QVB_Availability::get_slots( $service_ids['Deep Tissue Massage'], $staff_ids['Aisha Khan'], $date, array( 'admin' => true ) );

	if ( $slots ) {
		QVB_Bookings::create(
			array(
				'service_id' => $service_ids['Deep Tissue Massage'],
				'staff_id'   => $staff_ids['Aisha Khan'],
				'date'       => $date,
				'time'       => (string) array_key_first( $slots ),
				'name'       => 'Kavya Iyer',
				'email'      => 'kavya@example.com',
				'phone'      => '+91 90000 44444',
				'notes'      => 'Lower back pain after long desk days.',
				'consent'    => 1,
				'status'     => 'pending',
			),
			'admin'
		);
	}

}

QVB_Availability::flush_cache();
QVB_Settings::flush_cache();

echo 'Qevora demo ready: ' . count( $service_ids ) . ' services, ' . count( $staff_ids ) . ' staff, page #' . $page_id . '.';
